text: International Economics and Trade is an interdisciplinary subject that studies the patterns of cross-border flows of goods, services, capital, technology, etc. among countries (regions), as well as the operational mechanism of the global economic system. It integrates knowledge from various fields such as economics, management, law, and international relations. It focuses on core issues such as international trade theory and policies, international financial operations, cross-border enterprise management, and global supply chains. It not only explores macro-level questions like "Why does the trade between China and the United States generate a surplus?" and "How does RCEP affect regional trade?" but also addresses micro-level practical issues such as "How can enterprises avoid exchange rate risks?" and "How can cross-border e-commerce operate in compliance?" It is a key window for understanding economic interactions in the era of globalization.
